C.sf_caveat: Amato et al. 2022 (BMC Public Health, SF Pit Stop, Table 1): 3 sites that expanded to 24h were followed by +12.00 feces reports/week within 500 m (p=0.0016). Sites chosen for longer hours were the busiest, so this is confounded, not a causal harm estimate - but it is the only external estimate for the hours lever and it has the wrong sign.
